Ranchi University, Ranchi inviting online application for preparation of the panel for

Note: I) Horizontal Reservation will be given as per the policy of Jharkhand Government.
3) Noof requirement of Contractual Assistant Professors shall be according to need and
Income of the course.
15. This selection willbe purely on contractual basis for 11 months subject to reappointment on
satisfactory performance of candidates, This is also subject to courses run or till attainnment of
65 years of age of candidates whichever is earlier.
l6. The remuneration shall be as per decision of R.U. in respect of Self-Finance Vocational
Courses.
17. The application shal! only be submitted online through the link available on the official website
of Ranchi University (www.ranchiuniversity.ac.in).
18. The application submitted/sent through other modes like e-mail, or by hand shall be treated as
Invalid.
19. Recent self-attested pasport size photograph and signature of applicant shall be uploaded at
the proper place of the application.
20. All educational qualifications must have been obtained from recognized Universities/
Institution in India and/or abroad and if grades are awarded instead of marks, applicant should
dearly Indicate their numerical equivalent.
21. Interested candidates are required to apply through online (www.ranchiuniversity. ac. in) with
application fee of Rs. 1000/- (For General/EWS/OBC) and Rs. 500/- (For SC/ST/PH) in the
form of A/c payee DD in favour of "Registrar, Ranchi University, Ranchi" payable at Ranchi,
22. Print-out of online submitted form along with original D.D. and Self-attested copy of all the
relevant documents to be submitted in the office of the Director Council for Vocational Studies
through registered/speed post only by ....10.2024 till 5:00 PM.
23. Selection will be done in accordance with the statutes notified by the Department of Higher and
Technical Education. Govt. of Jharkhand vide Resolution No. 492 dated 24.02.2023.
Resolution No. 2589 dated 28.12.2023 and NCTE Regulation.
